items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: I met him in New York and we became friends or something.

ctx.x: I met him in New York and we became friends or something. And I left Dinah at one time, and he was going into the Cafe Bohemia, and he said, “well come on in, I’m going in for a month.” And I said okay. And I went in for a month with him and it was Cannon, Nat, Junior Mance and Specks Wright out of Philadelphia, and myself. And then I went back to Washington, I had to go back to Washington, and so he said, “well can you recommend a bass player?” And I said well a good friend of mine is Sam Jones, try and get him,…
I think it’s really fascinating how musicians recommend each other and they move around from group to group.
